fpi_reconciliation.scope_note: FPI Category I and II are separate from other foreign institutions. OverseasDepositories is included when explicitly reported; absent or nil components are not assumed to be zero.

semantics.ownership_fraction: XBRL reported decimal fraction; multiply by 100 for percentage points
semantics.shares: Reported share count from the NumberOfShares fact
semantics.missing: Absent or nil facts remain null; they are never converted to zero
semantics.attribution: Quarterly reported ownership, not daily trade flow or purchase date
